normative_extracts.quote: Each document has an associated top layer, an ordered set of elements rendered above all other elements in the document.

browser_support.notes: Top Layer existed for fullscreen and <dialog>.showModal() earlier, and expanded to Popover API across all browsers in 2024.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: The Top Layer is a document-level paint list rendered after the root stacking context, escaping ancestor overflow: hidden, clip-path, and z-index.

production_failures.symptom: Modal or tooltip appears clipped inside a scrollable card despite z-index: 99999
production_failures.root_cause: An ancestor has overflow: hidden, transform, or isolation: isolate, trapping the element inside a local stacking context.
production_failures.mitigation: Promote the overlay with <dialog>.showModal() or [popover].showPopover() to move it into the Browser Top Layer.

production_failures.symptom: Older popover covers a newer modal dialog opened on top of it
production_failures.root_cause: Top Layer paints in insertion (LIFO) order regardless of CSS z-index values.
production_failures.mitigation: Invoke showModal() / showPopover() in the exact order overlays should stack, and close stale popovers before opening lower layers.
